parameters.text:
=You are writing a short cold outreach email body from MRMtechsol to an Odoo partner company.

Recipient company name: {{ $json.name }}

Use the template below. Keep it almost identical: you may lightly adjust ONLY the greeting line and the first sentence so it naturally references that this company is an Odoo partner / implementer. Keep everything else, including the signature, exactly as written. Do not invent facts about the company. Output ONLY the final email body as plain text — no subject line, no markdown, no commentary.

TEMPLATE:
Hello,

I noticed that your company is currently expanding its Odoo implementation/development capabilities.

We are MRMtechsol, an Odoo technical consulting and development company. We can support your team remotely with custom module development, Python/XML/OWL development, API integrations, migrations, POS, Accounting, Inventory, HR/Payroll, reports and troubleshooting.

Instead of committing immediately, you can give us a small technical task to evaluate our development quality and communication.

If the result meets your expectations, we can continue on an hourly, task-based or ongoing support model.

Regards,
MRMtechsol
info@mrmtechsol.com

nodeGroups.name: Resolve country
nodeGroups.description: Looks up the country typed in the form and resolves its Odoo partner-directory URL.

nodeGroups.name: List all partners
nodeGroups.description: Reads every directory page for that country and collects all partner profile links, with no cap.

nodeGroups.name: Find partner emails
nodeGroups.description: Opens each partner profile and website and uses Groq AI to pick the best contact email; skips partners with none.

nodeGroups.name: Draft outreach emails
nodeGroups.description: Personalizes the MRMtechsol template per partner with Gemini and saves it as a Gmail draft to that partner.
